fact: The two members independently review the same candidate. The plugin collects both results before routing to Revise or Signoff.

A member finding names one exact Goal, Delivery or plan step ID and supplies a concrete counterexample, evidence and a correction. An approval identifies the reviewed version. The submission tool returns invalid targets to the same member for correction in the current turn.
The Lead addresses each finding individually in a revision or rebuttal. Both members review the resulting candidate before signoff.
